title: The best way to get to know Barcelona
text: On a weekend getaway, we met friends and one of them had read about this route. Sergio showed us around the center and pointed out things that go unnoticed by our untrained eyes. This guy makes a super enjoyable and fun route. The three hours it lasts flew by. I recommend it 100%.
author: joselu73s

title: A thousand stories to discover
text: Amazing tour of Barcelona. I never thought it hid so many secrets. We found it to be an amazing experience. Totally recommended, you will love it. Sergio, your guide, is a crack.
author: peponisimo

title: Impressive 😲
text: I would never have imagined that a visit would impact me so much, I had read about it on the Internet and about the work of the guide (Sergio) that I couldn't help but do it, now I have a perspective of Plaza Catalunya that I never would have imagined, it is the perfect gift for those friends and for oneself, all 10 thanks Sergio
author: Jarr R

title: SUGUS!!! ;))
text:
The best way to get to know Barcelona, with the best guide. A fun, surprising and cultural experience for the whole family.
Whether you come to visit or live here, it is a must-see. It was a totally successful gift from the Three Kings.
100% recommended
author: 5montser
